sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def piece_bbox(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('p','W') and 50 < n['pixels'] < 200:
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            if min(rs)<20: continue
            if min(rs)>=33 and max(rs)<=45 and min(cs)>=26 and max(cs)<=38: continue
            return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    return None
pos=piece_bbox(current_frame); print('start',pos)
action(['LEFT']); np=piece_bbox(current_frame); print('LEFT ->',np)
if np!=pos: pos=np
# if not N (25,31,26,37), try DOWN then LEFT
if pos!=(25,31,26,37):
    action(['DOWN']); np=piece_bbox(current_frame); print('DOWN ->',np)
    if np!=pos: pos=np
    action(['LEFT']); np=piece_bbox(current_frame); print('LEFT ->',np)
print('final pos', pos)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
